mentions.name: Isola
mentions.description: This tool lets users easily create and control sandboxes for executing untrusted code on any Kubernetes cluster with a single Helm install. It supports features such as on-demand snapshotting of specific containers' filesystems within a sandbox pod and egress rate limiting from the sandbox, with some capabilities enabled by upstream contributions to gVisor.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Isola (https://github.com/isola-run/isola), a passion project of mine. It allows you to easily create and control sandboxes for executing untrusted code on any Kubernetes cluster (one helm install).
